hooks.command: G=$(command -v git || echo '/c/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe'); cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if [ -n "$("$G" status --porcelain)" ]; then "$G" add -A && "$G" commit -q -m "Cambios automáticos del $(date '+%d/%m/%Y %H:%M')" && echo '{"systemMessage":"Commit automático hecho"}'; fi
